subject: Short customer snapshot for Capterra listing (e-gift offered)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@hearthlytech.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@hearthlytech.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick favor — two-line snapshot for Capterra listing

Hi Jessica,

Hope you and the Hearthly team are doing well — it was great to see the pilot usage ramp last month. I have a small favor to ask: we're updating our Capterra listing and would really appreciate a short, 1–2 sentence snapshot from you about the business impact you saw (e.g., latency improvements, cost per inference, or how the team used Redwood in production).

If it's easier, feel free to pick one of the bullets below and tweak:
- "Redwood cut our per-request latency by ~30% and simplified deployment across our dev/test/prod environments."
- "We lowered inference unit costs by about 20% after switching to Redwood's batching and cache settings."

As a thank-you, we'd like to send a $75 e-gift card (TangoCard or Visa e-gift) once the review is live. No rush — if you can post something within the next 10 days that would be super helpful for our upcoming marketing snapshot.

Link to the Capterra page: https://www.capterra.com/review/redwood-inference (attach when you post, we'll verify).

Attached is a one-line prompt you can paste to make it faster (capterra_short_prompt.txt). Happy to tailor examples if you prefer a different angle.

Thanks again for the partnership — let me know what card type works best and whether you'd like Ben or Laura looped in for the gift card processing.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Attachment: capterra_short_prompt.txt (text)

Thanks,

Hearthly Tech
